intent: Make the MARCHAND NPC-order coin bonus an exact 10% decimal increase rounded to whole coins, while leaving every other specialization on the base reward.
rationale: The existing MARCHAND branch multiplies an integer reward by a binary float literal before rounding. That can distort the intended decimal 10% calculation for valid integer inputs; for example, base 1572864 becomes 1730150.5 as float and rounds to 1730151 instead of the exact 1730150.4 -> 1730150. Reusing the class's existing BigDecimal and RoundingMode imports makes the percentage exact and keeps nearest-coin HALF_UP behavior for positive NPC rewards. The non-MARCHAND branch remains unchanged.
